name: Love of Magic
source:
Newly awoken to your powers and chased by undead creatures you arrive in Edinburgh to learn the arts of Magic. What awaits you, though, is a destiny 1,500 years in the making. Find true Love. Discover your Power. Play Poker.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1270210/Love_of_Magic/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
刚刚觉醒的你的力量并被不死生物追赶，你抵达爱丁堡学习魔法艺术。然而等待着你的是1500年来的命运。找到真爱。发现你的力量。玩扑克。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1270210/Love_of_Magic/]Steam[/url]]
